name: Vermont Custom Handrails and Metalwork LLC
old_description: Vermont Custom Handrails & Metalwork was founded in 2021 by James Lambert, a master fabricator with over twenty years of specialized experience. James works directly with homeowners and architects to transform structural requirements into artistic centerpieces.
about:
Vermont Custom Handrails & Metalwork operates from Hyde Park, Vermont, where it was founded in 2021 by James Lambert, a master fabricator with more than two decades of specialized experience. Lambert works directly with homeowners and architects to translate structural requirements into artistic centerpieces.

The company designs, fabricates, and installs custom stair and railing systems for residential and commercial projects across Vermont, New Hampshire, and New York. Its Hyde Park shop produces floating and wood-framed staircases, steel- and wood-framed decks, stainless-steel cable railings, spiral staircases, and ADA-compliant commercial railings. Every component is hand-crafted from high-grade stainless steel by a team whose combined experience exceeds 60 years, and the firm has completed more than 400 projects to date. Optional LED lighting, including cascading LEDs for monorail stairs and handrail-integrated LEDs, is available for architectural upgrades.

Clients range from individual homeowners building lakefront retreats or mountain lodges to architects and builders specifying commercial and ADA railings. The company's turnkey packages cover in-home consultation, custom design and fabrication, clean structural installation, and a final safety inspection with ongoing support.

Lambert started the business to combine heavy-duty engineering with clean, modern lines, delivering rock-solid, silent ascent systems that serve as signature architectural centerpieces. The firm emphasizes direct professional design collaboration, rigorous safety checks, and a commitment to lasting quality.

old_description: Gerard Bellavance founded United Steel Erectors in 1998. Since then, our name has changed, employees have come and gone, and Gerard’s sons; Gabriel, Eliott, and Addison have joined the leadership team. What hasn’t changed is our dedication to doing good work
about:
Vermont Steel Erection and Fabrication operates from Wolcott, Vermont. The business began in 1998 when Gerard Bellavance founded United Steel Erectors; the name later changed to its current form. It remains a family-owned company, with Bellavance's sons Gabriel, Eliott, and Addison now sharing leadership responsibilities.

The firm provides structural steel erection, custom steel fabrication, and welding services throughout New England. Its shop performs MIG, TIG, and stick welding on items ranging from heavy equipment and vehicles to dumpsters and storage racks, and technicians can also travel to job sites for on‑location welding. The company stresses that well‑fabricated steel delivered on schedule prevents costly project delays.

Primary customers are general contractors, industrial facilities, and commercial project owners needing steel installation or fabricated components. The company's welding work covers agricultural, construction, and transportation equipment, though no specific industry sectors are called out beyond the New England region.

The founder's original goal was simply to do good work, a principle the company says it has never compromised; it cites a record of never failing to complete a job satisfactorily, an excellent safety record, and a commitment to quick, efficient turnaround as its defining differentiators.

about:
Virginia Panel Corporation (VPC) is headquartered in Waynesboro, Virginia. The company does not publicly disclose its founding year, ownership structure, or the names of its founders.

VPC manufactures cable assemblies and interconnect solutions for test and measurement applications. Its product line includes discrete-wired cable assemblies that incorporate proprietary VPC modules with customer-specified connectors, as well as slide-off backshells designed for easy wiring access during maintenance and probing. The company also provides digital engineering tools such as a Wirelist Template for communicating project requirements, a Cable Solution Selector that matches PXI instruments with VPC receivers, and a Patchcord Designer supporting over 70 contact and patchcord combinations. These tools are intended to accelerate quoting, reduce errors, and lower labor costs.

The company serves customers in the automotive, aerospace, defense, medical, and telecommunications sectors. Its solutions are used in applications including hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) testing, ECU testing, signal conditioning, RF and microwave testing, and environmental testing. VPC’s interconnect products align with industry standards such as PXI, VXI, VDATS, and CASS.

VPC emphasizes that its engineering team and digital toolset are designed to decrease quote and order turnaround times, reduce the risk of human error, and save customers time and money. The firm positions its combination of manufactured interconnect hardware and configuration software as a way to streamline the connection between test instruments and receivers.

name: Vital Farms - Egg Central Station
old_description: We do everything we can to improve the lives of people, animals, and the planet through food. By empowering family farms, putting animal welfare first, and raising the bar on what’s sold in grocery stores, we’re proving a better food system is possible.
about:
Vital Farms’ Egg Central Station operates in Springfield, Missouri. The facility was established in 2015 as part of Vital Farms, a company that traces its roots to 2007 when its founders set out to prove that animal welfare, family farms, and food quality could scale together. The business is structured as a certified B Corporation and operates under a stakeholder model that considers farmers, animals, crew members, stockholders, the environment, community, vendors, and consumers.

The plant handles multiple product lines including pasture-raised, organic, restorative, and True Blues eggs, as well as hard-boiled and liquid whole eggs. The company reports 39,000-plus acres of pasture rotated annually and distribution to roughly 24,000 retailers nationwide.

The primary customers are grocery retailers and food-service distributors across the United States. Vital Farms’ eggs appear in major supermarket chains and natural-food stores, serving consumers who prioritize animal welfare and regenerative agriculture. The company also sells directly to consumers through its website and farm tours.

Vital Farms says its differentiation lies in its B Corp certification, Certified Humane standards, and a commitment to regenerative practices—59 percent of its farmer partners use regenerative methods. The business was started to demonstrate that ethical food production can be commercially viable at scale.

name: Vital Plastics, LLC
old_description: . We specialize in high-volume production, supported by a wide range of molding equipment with capacities from 30 to 400 tons. From prototyping to full-scale manufacturing, our mission is to exceed your expectations in both molding and assembly.
about:
Vital Plastics, LLC was founded in 1994 in Baldwin, Wisconsin, located east of the Twin Cities metro area along Interstate 94. The company operates two manufacturing facilities in Baldwin and has grown to become a custom plastic injection molding and assembly solutions provider.

The company specializes in high-volume injection molding with 56 all-electric presses ranging from 30 to 400 tons, supporting processes such as insert molding, over molding, and two-shot molding. Its 70,000 square feet of climate-controlled manufacturing space houses a cellular manufacturing model and leverages RJG scientific molding practices alongside IQMS integration for real-time production monitoring. Beyond molding, Vital Plastics offers comprehensive assembly services including automated, semi-automated, and hand-set assembly, heat staking, hot stamping, ultrasonic welding, pad printing, and kitting. Tooling solutions cover maintenance, design, modifications, and warehousing, while the quality lab provides CMM inspection, optical comparators, and PPAP documentation up to Level 5.

Vital Plastics serves multiple industries and has supplied Fortune 1000 companies since 2009. Its engineering expertise spans prototype through production runs, with materials ranging from commodity and engineered grades to filled, unfilled, and high-temperature exotic resins. The company also supports metal-to-plastic conversion projects.

The company emphasizes its "Vital Difference" mission, centering customers, community, and employees. It reports a 99.86% on-time delivery rate and has shipped over 700 million assembled components with a 0.004% defect rate, backed by ISO 9001:2015 certification and in-process inspection protocols.

about:
Voyager Electronics Corporation was founded in 1982 in Minneapolis, Minnesota, as a distributor of electronic components and a manufacturer of cable-related solutions. The company remains privately held, though its ownership structure is not publicly specified.

The firm supplies a broad range of components — circuit protection devices, switches, connectors, power supplies, capacitors, and audio products — while also producing custom cable assemblies, wire harnesses, and value-added kits through its subsidiary, Best Source Electronics Corporation, established in 1997. Voyager’s in-house services include assembly, engineering design and prototyping, continuity and functional testing, custom fixture creation, kitting, electronic data interchange (EDI), and just-in-time delivery programs. No facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures are disclosed.

Voyager serves customers across industrial, medical, aerospace, defense, automotive, IoT, automation, and agriculture sectors. Its client base includes manufacturers of telecom equipment and industrial electrical products, and it partners with component brands such as ZEUS Battery Products, Allied Components, Switch Components Inc., Tenergy Corporation, and Curtis Industries.

The company emphasizes its ISO 9001:2015 certified quality management system and a philosophy of bringing value through collaborative engineering, supply-chain consolidation, and responsive service. Its founding aim was to provide quality products and outstanding customer service while creating solutions for diverse electronic-component needs.
